failures.rule: The options can't be told apart at board size, or they differ in something besides the decision.
failures.place: Item captions beneath the photos, comparing the left airy screen with the right standard screen.
failures.issue: The airy screen stacks each platform icon above the item title; the standard screen places it beside the title and price. This changes the caption layout as well as spacing, so the board does not isolate R8. Keep the icon-and-text arrangement consistent across both densities and options.

across_options.issue: A's airy screen puts platform icons above titles, while B keeps icons beside titles. That additional layout change confounds the spacing comparison.
